analysis.title: The AI fragility trap (The AI Boom Is Hiding Something Very Ugly)
key_insights: BofA: US tech is on track for its second most fragile year in over three decades, behind only 2025. Earnings reactions are getting more violent without a matching deterioration in fundamentals, which BofA attributes to weaker conviction, AI uncertainty and reflexive positioning.
GS: combined hyperscaler capex reached $230.4B in Q3, up 118% YoY. Investor concern is shifting to the cost of the buildout and the time needed to earn adequate returns.
GS: combined quarterly hyperscaler free cash flow fell to negative $31.4B. Microsoft is the only major hyperscaler still generating positive FCF.

GS: global hyperscaler bond issuance reached $254B, above Goldman's $250B full-year forecast. Microsoft issued $25B last week, and total US investment-grade issuance is above $2T YTD, a record with two months left.
GS: Amazon's long-term debt rose from $66B to $173B in nine months.

GS: the firm's 30-year hyperscaler credit basket had its most volatile week of the year, with average daily spread moves of 6.3 bps, nearly three times the YTD average. The basket ended the week roughly unchanged and the broader IG index widened 1 bp.

GS: the B- to CCC spread reached 8 percentage points, a level seen fewer than five times since 1996. In every prior case the S&P 500 was at least 11.5% below its 52-week high, and in two cases almost 30% below. This time the index was less than 2% below its high.

GS: with the S&P 500 about 3% below its all-time high, 60% of its constituents were already in bear-market territory. The Mag 7 lost $4T in market cap since October 15. Oracle is down 50% from its peak, Arm 49% and Broadcom 31%.

BofA: its Bubble Risk Indicator shows healthcare and staples with some of the most extreme price dynamics, and cybersecurity is one of the few themes above the bubble-risk threshold. The defensive rotation is becoming crowded in price-action terms.
BofA: only 13 S&P 500 stocks show extreme bubble-like price action, 2.2% of index market cap. At the dot-com peak the comparable readings covered 50-100 stocks and 20-40% of market cap.

BofA: IGV and SMH December call spreads offer some of the most attractive upside payout ratios among liquid ETFs. A clearing event around the midterms could trigger a sharp recovery, and call spreads cap losses at the premium paid.

tension_points.theme: AI equity fragility vs credit stress
tension_points.bull_case: BofA says speculative excess is far narrower than in 1999, with 13 stocks and 2.2% of S&P 500 market cap showing extreme bubble-like price action. It also says a clearing event around the midterms could trigger a sharp recovery in tech.

tension_points.what_invalidates: A clearing event around the midterms would invalidate the bear case and trigger a recovery, per BofA.
